Package index

Workflow

The steps of an analysis, in order: describe the design, fit the responses, choose the null models, estimate and classify the interactions, compare the null models and report the methods.

describe_design()
Describe what a multiple-stressor design can identify
fit_responses()
Fit a GLMM to each response, choosing its error distribution
suggest_null_models()
Suggest null models from what is known about the stressors
estimate_interactions()
Estimate single, combined and interaction effects under null models
summary(<must_interactions>)
Summarise estimated interactions
plot(<must_interactions>)
Plot estimated interactions
classify_interactions()
Classify interactions (Piggott et al. 2015)
compare_null_models()
Agreement between null models on each interaction
report_interactions()
Report the methods and the decisions of an analysis
